scope.mode: Future acquisition/discovery handoff; preparation uses local sources only. This turn performs no web search or external dispatch.

boundaries.source_classes: Original human randomized and nonrandomized studies, observational studies, case series/reports; animal, cell/ex-vivo and computational originals separately labeled. Protocols, supplements, registry results, corrections/retractions/replacements linked to the parent family. REVIEW/TEXTBOOK/OTHER and official context remain separate.
boundaries.inclusions: Database inception through2026-10-09; all languages. Include positive, null, harmful, contrary, replication, discontinued and unpublished/registry findings. Discover paywalled records even when retrieval fails. Exact indication/population/route/comparator boundaries govern applicability.
boundaries.exclusions: No vendor efficacy claims, Reddit anecdotes as clinical evidence, duplicate independent-study counting, unrelated homonyms, invented papers/DOIs, or silently substituted combinations. No excluded CP28 CSVs. No brand names in publishable copy.
boundaries.required_files: Lawful original report PDF plus available supplementary appendices, protocol/statistical plan, correction/retraction/replacement notices. Full HTML is a disclosed fallback, not a recovered PDF. Relevant official identity/original-use/safety context is separately classified.
boundaries.completion: Run and log all relevant index, registry and citation-chasing searches; reconcile every screened record, returned file, identity conflict and access gap. Report incomplete until unresolved scope/access work is explicit. No fixed PDF quota and no source count proves efficacy.

scope.count_policy: 30 distinct generic drug entities; sirolimus/rapamycin one entity, nirmatrelvir with ritonavir one regimen entity. No umbrella cancer, symptoms, formulations, longevity goals or aliases inflate30 conditions.
scope.demand_limit: Owner-required itraconazole + observed provisional Reddit questions + source-located CP28 expansion + safety/null-result value. This is an editorial starting selection, not a measured top30 ranking.
scope.not_a_pdf_quota: 30drugs+30conditions are coverage axes, not30PDFs,900pair claims, or a guarantee of available human studies.

delivery.layout: return/Fxx/acquisition-return.json plus PRIMARY/<source_id>__<role>__<shorttitle>.pdf and CONTEXT/{REVIEW,TEXTBOOK,OTHER}/<source_id>.<ext>. Derived OCR/text kept apart with source hash. No source PDF embedded in this outgoing packet.
delivery.required_fields: Actual downloaded bytes/hash/MIME, original/resolvedURL, retrieval time, rights/license or missing reason, access state, title/authors/year/DOI printed and separately verified, PMID/registry, collection/tier/design/report/family/version links, all applicable request/drug/condition/demand IDs.
delivery.missingness: Unknown metadata remains null with explanation. doi_printed is DOI NOT PRINTED when absent. A newly verified DOI is stored separately with authoritative verification provenance; never overwrite a blank CP28manifest DOI. Future scientific facts absent from sources remain NOT IN CORPUS.
delivery.reverse_prompt: Mandatory CHATGPT-INGEST-PROMPT.txt and identical full final copyable block, filled from actual delivered files; blocked-transfer branch required when attachments unavailable.
delivery.receipt: Actual access/hashes verified independently by receiving Mission Control; sender cannot assert receiver access. check_packet.py --return-file requires --delivery-receipt.

search_protocol.conditional_databases: Embase/CENTRAL when available; log access limitations. Do not fabricate execution.
search_protocol.query_rules: Translate neutral per-request queries and condition/drug aliases; separately search human originals, preclinical originals, harms/nulls and registry results. Do backward/forward citation chasing, exact identity lookups and a final update through cutoff.
search_protocol.logs: Exact query/database/filter/time/hits/exported IDs; title/abstract screening decisions and exclusions; missing hits count remains null with reason. All-language discovery, original language preserved, significant translation awaiting qualified verification.

identity: Deduplicate reports by verified DOI/PMID/title/authors/year and exact file hashes. One source can support many requests. Family links use registration/cohort/experiment identity; report/protocol/supplement/review are not independent studies. Ambiguous merges remain unresolved. Preserve all preexistingCP28andpilot IDs and quarantine.

verification.acquisition: Validate JSON schema, exact files/hash/MIME, safe paths, per-request links, collection/tier, counts and source-version conflicts. No URL or HTML challenge may count asPDF.
verification.later_ingestion: Not authorized by this fetch-only worker contract. Before substantive extraction, persist a plan-matched source receipt, exact hashes and assignments, validate applicable source-record schema (bundledCP28v2 supports model/review/chapter records) and any typed result/synthesis extension. Recheck affected readiness first.
verification.source_extraction_when_authorized: Capture only printed drug/originaluse/newindication, design, population/model, exactN/arms, numerical outcomes/units/timepoints/uncertainty/harms and stated limitations with file, printed/PDFpage or EPUBchapter/XPath, table/figure and sourcehash. Numbers absent: NOT IN CORPUS; preserve context tiers. Inspect important tables/figures.
verification.audit_when_authorized: All launch-supporting claims/criticalnumbers and a recorded stratified sample; original results, author conclusions and reviewer judgments separate. Appraisal/Q01–Q15 are a separate reviewed layer, not acquisition metadata.

mapping.graph: request/drug/condition/DR → source/report → studyfamily/experiment → locatedresult → scopedclaim → synthesisrow → overview/conditionpage/FAQ/review/citation; originalpaper and context remain distinct.
mapping.reader_output: Drug overview explains identity/originaluse and proposeduses. Shared condition/use/outcome rows feed both drug and condition pages, including population/comparator, finding, magnitude/uncertainty, evidencecertainty orNotappraised, independentfamilies/design, principal limitation and source/review state.
mapping.typed_synthesis_boundary: The future result/claim/synthesis schema and sharedrenderer must be tested before those new data are accepted or published. This acquisition schema carries request/page targets and sourceprovenance, not prefilled efficacy or grades.
mapping.clinical_directness: Human efficacy, preclinicalonly, noeligibleevidence in searchedscope and missingfulltext are different states.

recovery.attempts: Try publisher, authoritative repository and author/institution copy where lawful; log each route. Return inaccessible/identityconflict as gaps. Never bypass access control.
recovery.resume: Immutable sourcebytes and sourceIDs; changedfile is a version linked to priorhash. Retry only open gaps. Repeating same return must produce zero new canonical records.
recovery.rollback: Stage under work/ingest/FETCH30/<batch>/<attempt>; snapshot acceptedcorpus before any laterimport. Preserve packet1.1history and oldCP28records. Failedreturns remain quarantined, existingdata unchanged.
